items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: I was influenced by my teacher, Red Calendar.

ctx.x: I think you just have an urge to live that's unquenchable.

I think I got (inaudible) by everything. I was influenced by my teacher, Red Calendar. (Inaudible) Buddy Collette inspired me a whole lot, coming up together with him. And Phil Moore. I studied with him, composition. No, I studied with him arranging. Gave me my first organ. That's why I started using (inaudible) organ. And I was writing some things out for him, too. I don't know if he ever used them or not, but he asked me to write something. He said, "How would you -- if you had a record date where they told you…
